reason: The paired M2S comparison found a 33.637843 training-nat improvement at omega=2, failing the frozen cold-only acceptance threshold. Stop further pairs for futility and use cold+64 narrow starts for M2S.
chosen_algorithm: Three concept-disjoint outer folds, no inner selection; G4 versus X5 including M3S; 8 cold starts for other members, 8 cold plus 64 keyed narrow starts for M2S; cap .03 and median repeated-study target.
cost_repair: Three folds instead of five reduce outer member fits from 45 to 27. Training sizes become 42/43 rather than 50-52 for the declared family profile, using the existing per-family offset. Both point cost and predictive performance must be requalified at these sizes.
cpu_cap: 7200 minus original prototype CPU minus completed paired-fold CPU minus 450 seconds reserved conservatively for interrupted in-flight fits and other checks. The new probe stops before another fit when less than 120 CPU seconds remain. It is one CPU process.
interpretation: Development points and cost, no interval transferred from the old five-fold calibration. No global start-policy adoption, production edits, remote work or licensed scientific decision.
